class.name: SteamVoice
class.brief_description: Steam voice decoding and opt-in microphone access for one client start.

method.name: capture
method.description: Returns the scope's microphone controls without starting capture. A new unattached service has no capture handle. A retained handle returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] after its scope stops.

method.name: decode
method.description: Decodes one complete Steam voice frame of 1 to 8192 bytes. Zero chooses Steam's recommended rate, or pass a rate from 11025 to 48000 Hz. The result contains up to 131072 bytes of signed 16-bit mono PCM. Unavailable codecs and invalid input return a typed error.
